reviews.title: This app is not what it is cracked up to be
reviews.text: The app itself is decent. It is too expensive. The people that made the app excluded all the good ones for the people that actually pay and all like the decent like sort of like bad ones for the other people that didn’t pay. I had a lot of glitches with trying to get some of the backgrounds on my screen, especially the moving backgrounds and also just as someone wants a good aesthetic or cute or cool whatever they want you shouldn’t have to pay for such a simple wish like who would want to pay money every single month just so you can have a cool background on your iPad or phone talking about that. I feel like this app just relates to phones like it doesn’t relate to iPads too cause whenever I tried to put a background on my iPad, it would look weird anyways my overall problems with this app is that it’s too expensive. My suggestion is making it cheaper or abolishing it completely. My other problem is that you really need to fix a lot of glitches and I know that the person that made the app can’t come to me. He probably here she probably won’t but it’s fine cause I know that they have a lot of reviews and that they probably don’t read all of them so yeah anyways my overall reading is two stars because again from the title, this app is not what it’s cracked up to be.
